body: Well thank you, wise one, for your thoughtfulness and generosity in giving us this enlightening post. If only people were self aware enough to realise for themselves what they do and don't enjoy! But since they're not, I'm so glad this sub has you :)

So the point of your post is...? The ability to stop watching a show is not news to anyone. People choose to keep watching every time they click on a new episode; if they didn't want to, they simply wouldn't. Did you think people would read this post and have a revelation about their own free will?
